discipline: Exactly ONE canonical Arabic form (the canonical side) and ONE canonical English rendering per term. The glossary must never silently contain two renderings of one term. A term is never invented from recall without a fetched, cited grounding. Append-only in history.

growth_protocol.summary: The documented procedure every future component invokes on encountering an Islamic-finance term of art NOT in the glossary.
steps: (a) research the term on demand against public authoritative sources
(b) propose a bilingual entry with its grounding cited
(c) append with status: provisional — usable immediately, but routed into the principal's consolidated review list at the next checkpoint; his calibration flips it to locked

(d) validation: no entry may conflict with a locked (or locked-pending-calibration) rendering; collisions fail closed and surface for human resolution; the glossary is versioned and append-only in history

entries.definition_ar: بيعٌ بثمنٍ يساوي التكلفةَ مضافاً إليها ربحٌ معلوم، مع الإفصاح التامّ عن التكلفة والربح (أحد بيوع الأمانة).
entries.definition_en: A sale at a price equal to cost plus a known profit, with full disclosure of cost and markup (one of the trust sales, buyu' al-amanah).
Physical, actual receipt and taking of the asset.

entries.definition_ar: قبضٌ تقديريٌّ بالتمكين والتخلية ونقلِ تبعةِ الهلاك دون تسلّمٍ مادّيٍّ مباشر.
entries.definition_en: Constructive possession by enablement, clearing of the asset, and transfer of the risk of loss, without direct physical receipt.

sources: Input #2, Part 2 (Murabaha condition b — actual or constructive possession)

entries.definition_ar: وعدٌ يُلزَم به الواعدُ بإتمام المعاملة؛ وإلزامُه في المرابحة للآمر بالشراء محلُّ خلاف (انظر D1).
entries.definition_en: A promise by which the promisor is held bound to complete the transaction; its bindingness in MPO is contested (see D1).

entries.definition_ar: بيعُ سلعةٍ بثمنٍ مؤجّلٍ ثمّ إعادةُ شرائها نقداً بأقلَّ من بائعها الأصلي؛ ممنوعٌ في دول الخليج.
entries.definition_en: Selling a good on deferred terms then buying it back for cash at a lower price from its original seller; prohibited across the GCC.

entries.definition_ar: الزيادةُ المعلومةُ على التكلفة التي يتّفق عليها بوصفها ربحَ المرابحة.
entries.definition_en: The known increment over cost agreed as the Murabaha profit.

entries.definition_ar: المحلُّ المعنويُّ الذي يثبت فيه الدَّينُ والالتزامُ في ذمّة المدين.
entries.definition_en: The legal locus in which a debt and obligation are established as a charge on the debtor.

sources: Input #2, Part 2 (Murabaha — deferred sale price as a debt); Tawarruq (financial obligation)

entries.definition_ar: كلُّ زيادةٍ مشروطةٍ مضمونةٍ على قرضٍ أو دَين (ربا النسيئة)، أو تفاضلٍ في مبادلةِ جنسٍ ربويٍّ واحدٍ يداً بيد (ربا الفضل).
entries.definition_en: Any stipulated, guaranteed increase on a loan or debt (riba al-nasiah), or an unequal hand-to-hand exchange of the same riba-bearing genus (riba al-fadl).

entries.definition_ar: الغموضُ أو المخاطرةُ في أركان العقد؛ يُفسِدُ العقدَ إذا كان فاحشاً، ويُغتفَر إذا كان يسيراً.
entries.definition_en: Ambiguity or hazard in the essential elements of a contract; it vitiates the contract when excessive (fahish) and is tolerated when minor (yasir).

entries.definition_ar: بيعٌ لا يُفصَح فيه عن التكلفة، بخلاف المرابحة.
entries.definition_en: A sale in which the cost is not disclosed, unlike Murabaha.

sources: Input #2, Part 2 (Murabaha condition c — distinguished from musawamah)

entries.definition_ar: بيعٌ يُؤجَّل فيه دفعُ الثمن إلى أجلٍ أو يُقسَّط، وهو الصورةُ المعتادةُ للمرابحة المصرفية.
entries.definition_en: A sale in which payment of the price is deferred or paid in instalments — the usual form of banking Murabaha.

entries.definition_ar: تمويلٌ بالسلع للحصول على نقدٍ يرتّب المصرفُ سلسلتَه كاملةً ويتوكّل في طرفيه؛ مسألةٌ خلافية خارج نطاق المرابحة (انظر D3).
entries.definition_en: Commodity financing to obtain cash where the bank arranges the whole chain and acts as agent on both legs; a contested matter outside Murabaha scope (see D3).
entries.scope_note: Out-of-Murabaha-scope; seeded as a boundary marker only.

entries.definition_ar: بيعٌ بثمنٍ يساوي تكلفةَ الاقتناء دون زيادةٍ ولا ربح، مع الإفصاح التامّ عن التكلفة؛ أحدُ بيوع الأمانة الثلاثة إلى جانب المرابحة (تكلفة + ربح) والوضيعة (بيعٌ بخسارة).
entries.definition_en: A sale at a price equal to the acquisition cost with no markup or profit, with full cost disclosure; one of the three trust sales (buyu' al-amanah) alongside Murabaha (cost + profit) and wadiah (sale at a loss).
entries.scope_note: Encountered on demand (not seeded). Demonstrates the growth protocol running end-to-end: researched → provisional entry → routed to the consolidated review list.
entries.review_routing: Consolidated Arabic review list (rendered/ARABIC_REVIEW_LIST.md), provisional section — awaiting the principal's calibration to flip to locked.

sources: Fincyclopedia, 'Tawliyah' (fincyclopedia.net/islamic-finance/t/tawliyah) — par-value/at-cost sale, full cost disclosure, no markup
Ijara CDC glossary, 'Bayu al-amanah' (ijaracdc.com) — three trust sales: murabaha, tawliyah, wadiah
Wikipedia, 'Murabaha' — murabaha as one of three buyu' al-amanah requiring honest cost declaration
